comments.body: anybody know good way to level this skill?

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: The guilds and archives around Naples and Venice are your best bet. Compared to the other adventure skills (Archeology, Geography, etc) there's not that many quests and maps to work off of to grind this skill.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: If you have completed City of ancient Mesopotamia, Glory of Ur, and a quest called "Babylonian Romance", the directions of which can be found under the comments of Mercator Estate, you can obtain a new "weapon" item called the Babylonian Harp, which has 10 Formality, 10 Disguise, +2 Art/Appraisal, +1 Persuasion, 100 Durability, and requires 10k fame to equip. It has no Effect skill, however.

wiki: Refine effect: Increase Fame from Discovery reports
